page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre ("EPISTOLÆ"), page number at top right. Three letter headings, each followed by a paragraph. No marginal notes. Signature "F 5" at the foot, left of the last line. Edge fragments at the left and right edges are from the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Eth. SOCRATES CLEONI. LII.
Quando lupi magna prœda potiti sunt, &
satie-tate sibi temperant, abstinent quodam modo ab
agnis, & more isto fero in humanitatem verso
mirabili quadam iustitia imbuuntur à satietate. cum
quibus enim una pascunt, & parcunt donec venter
latrauerit. Sed tu lupis morem habes impudentio-
rem, & co auariori multo es intemperantia, quan-
do aurum catuziunt tui thesauri, non secus atque
ebriis accidere solet: qui cum vino saturati sunt,
tamen sitiunt, & in ebrietate, ebrietatis augent ve-
hementiam. propter enim summam copiam ad
contrariam dispositionem exhilarante simul & ex-
urente vino, ebriosi dilabuntur. apage intempe-
rantem ebrietatem isthanc intemperans, nequan-
doque, si fortuna ea, quæ dedit, auferat, ad contra-
riam partem devoluaris; talibus enim pœnis im-
moderatos castigat atque temperat.
Ruff. MINTHES RHIZONI. LIII.
Fluvius Chrysippus agelli mei partem furatus
est, & agro tuo vindicauit stultum quid commit-
tens, & vecors in re aliena sibi potestatem facit. sed
si quidem tribunalis onus tuis humeris ferre non
es par, donis fluvij ne fruaris, si vero alienis rebus
gaudes, non multo post flebis privatus & exu-
tus tuis.
eAmat. MEDEA IASONI. LIV.
Nihil ita positum est in studio hominis, aut fa-
stidio, quàm affectio amatoria, vbi tibi lacrimarum
flumina

page.notes: The heading abbreviations "Eth." and "Ruff." and "eAmat." are read as printed and are doubtful; the first may be a worn "Epist.". "catuziunt" is read as printed and may be a misprint. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout, so "isthanc" and "si" are read from the long-s forms. The page is cut off at the foot after "flumina"; the paragraph continues on the next page.
